info.description: The Antimon Recliner Detail Management API enables businesses to create detailed specifications for the Antimon Recliner product. This API allows users to provide comprehensive information about the recliner, including materials, dimensions, and features. Typical consumers of this API include product managers, catalog administrators, and e-commerce platforms looking to enhance their product offerings with detailed descriptions. By streamlining the catalog creation process, this API supports improved product visibility and customer engagement.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for the Antimon recliner. You can provide specific attributes and characteristics of the recliner that will be stored in the system, allowing for better tracking and display of product information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for creating or updating an Antimon recliner. It must conform to the specified JSON schema and includes all required fields to be processed successfully.
